annotations.text:
GRANULE — asphalt-shingle charcoal + safety orange.
Two Home layouts: Stack (today's shape) and Command (one huge action, tool rail, then the day).
Every artboard exposes accent / bg / surface / ink as tweaks — recolour any screen without touching markup.
VERDIGRIS — copper roofing and the patina it ages into, on a bone ground. Light-mode counterpart; accent + copper are separate tweaks.
The rest of the app in Granule. Storm Tracer shows the new select-pins → Save → Start route bar; Capture shows the 10×10 test square with live hit detection against the 8-hit carrier bar.
